title.en: An Act Declaring September 29 of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of Balilihan, Province of Bohol
title.orig: An Act Declaring September 29 of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Municipality of Balilihan, Province of Bohol

text.en: September 29 of every year as a special nonworking public holiday in the Municipality of Balilihan, province of Bohol to commemorate its Sumad Day or foundation anniversary.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days from its publication in the Official Gazette or in at least two (2) newspaper of general circulation.
